feeds.note: Single feed carries several formats; classified per-episode by shows.classify()

feeds.name: Animal Spirits
feeds.note: Feed URL to be resolved. Macro/ETF weighted separately in the ranker.

classification.comment: Weekday is the primary signal; title shape corroborates. Raw weekday and title are stored so episodes can be reclassified without re-fetching.

show_weights.comment: Starting weights for the ranker. Re-fit monthly from realized exits.

youtube.comment: Per-show playlists avoid the clip/shorts noise on the main channel and give show classification for free. Ask The Compound is out of scope per the plan.

match.comment: Titles are unusable for WAYT (YouTube re-headlines them), so match on date+duration. Title similarity is only a tiebreaker.
